verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS remote-access product that stores session data and AI-generated session summaries, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents audit logs, AI session summaries and historical monitoring data, but nothing about letting users configure retention periods or delete stored data. The community items cover billing, credential storage and scam abuse, which are off-topic for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
